Wacker Chemie Targets Margin Growth Under New Financial Plan
By Adam Whittaker
German chemical company Wacker Chemie said cost savings and tightened investment criteria will lead to margin growth under a new financial plan.
Wacker said Thursday that it is targeting an earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization margin of around 15%, a roughly 50% increase to its average over the past three years.

This will be aided by cost savings of more than 300 million euros, equivalent to $343.9 million, annually starting in 2028, it said. It is also planning to focus investment on growth markets across electronics, healthcare and mobility. Investments are seen between 300 million euros and 400 million euros a year in the coming years, it said.
The company said it aims outpace global economic growth, and increase profitability with returns on capital employed above 10%.
Wacker sees third quarter Ebitda on par with the 211 million euros it reported in the second quarter, it said.
